messages:
oliver: Quick release-train pulse — entering a 12h quiet window starting 2026-03-25 18:00 PT for rollout v3.8.1. Please hold non-critical deploys. Canary looks stable but we saw a small embedding latency bump in eu. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/releases/378

sre-oncall: noted. we're watching the eu pool, p95 +30ms over baseline. digging into batch config and queue depth.

raj: Is this the same regression we saw last week? any correlation with quant changes or new kernel picks?

emily: No quant/model changes. We did push an autoscaler tweak to reduce cold starts yesterday — rolled that change back in canary ~17:40 PT. Monitoring impact now.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: 2026-03-25T17:42Z — canary v3.8.1 -> 3 nodes. status: SUCCESS ✅

maria: Freezing non-security infra changes until 06:00 PT tomorrow. Exceptions allowed for urgent hotpatches with approval from @oliver + @sre-oncall.

oliver: To request an exemption, post a short justification here (risk, rollback plan). I'll approve only if it's urgent and low-risk.

raj: Requesting exemption for small metrics-agent bump (infra-only, minor config). Will include rollback window. cc @maria

maria: Approved. Tag the rollout with `exempt/metrics-bump` and include the exact rollback command in the release notes.

oliver: Emergency rollback command (bookmark):
```
./releasectl rollback --env=prod --tag=v3.8.1-canary --reason="eu-latency-regress"
```

sre-oncall: FYI runbook update: autoscale thresholds and alert thresholds adjusted -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscale (minor wording change).

emily: Quick ask: please avoid heavy manual load testing against eu canaries for the next 30m — we want a clean signal.

oliver: Thanks — I’ll post an update in 30m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (17:55 PT): cpu 65%, p95 +28ms, errors 0.2% (within threshold).

oliver: Update 17:58 PT — canary remains stable, eu latency trending down after autoscaler rollback. Lifting: no additional deploys allowed until 2026-03-26 10:00 PT. If anything changes, escalate to @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Muting noisy alerts for next 45m to avoid paging storms while we watch trend.

maria: Great work. We'll capture notes and follow-ups in the weekly release doc.

oliver: Closing thread in 1h if stability holds. Thanks all.
